attributes.title: 2027 ACA Conference & Expo
attributes.summary:
The 2027 ACA Conference & Expo runs March 11 to 13, 2027, at the Oregon Convention Center in Portland and marks the American Counseling Association's 75th anniversary. Optional Learning Institutes (member $99, student member $49, non-member $199) take place before the main program opens.

Full-conference fees step up on December 22, 2026 and again on March 9, 2027. Members pay $410 early, $525 regular and $630 late; non-members pay $675, $775 and $875. The $315–$475 tier covers student, new professional and retired members, and student non-members register by phone. ACA lists the conference for counselors seeking continuing education; the exact number of CE hours and the NBCC details are not published yet.

The headquarters hotel is the Hyatt Regency Portland at $269 per night until February 15, 2027. Refund requests close on March 4, 2027.
